title: Water stored: one beaver dam vs. an Olympic swimming pool (million gallons)
notes: An Ecology-funded study measuring 29 beaver ponds across 12 complexes in the Columbia Basin found an average beaver dam stores about 1.1 million gallons (3.5 acre-feet) of surface water. An Olympic-size swimming pool (50m x 25m x 2m, the FINA-standard competition volume) holds approximately 660,000 US gallons -- a widely cited standard conversion, included here for scale, not as a government-sourced figure.
